reason: The README clearly describes a DeepSeek Harness integration whose primary purpose is persistent project memory: loading checkpoint context, saving sessions through MemoryHub, providing memory tools, and exposing a Memory web UI.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供基于 MemoryHub 的项目记忆加载、保存、查询工具和记忆可视化标签页。
summaries.en: Provides DeepSeek Harness with MemoryHub-based project memory loading, saving, querying tools, and a visual Memory tab.

capabilities: Loads project memory into session context
Saves session transcripts and summaries to MemoryHub checkpoints
Exposes memory management tools and a runtime skill
Spawns a local MemoryHub web UI process and embeds it in a web tab
